section_summary.extract_value: A repeated-measures ANOVA showed a significant within-group effect, F(3,238) = 166.52, p < .001, indicating mean differences across figures representing participants' current, personal ideal, ethnic group ideal, and typical ethnic female peer body size (adjusted for BMI). Bonferroni-corrected post hoc tests indicate current body size was larger than personal ideal (p < .001, d = 0.42) and ethnic group ideal (p = .001, d = 0.17), smaller than the typical peer (p < .001, d = -0.41), with additional pairwise differences reported (e.g., personal ideal smaller than ethnic group ideal and typical peer; ethnic group ideal smaller than typical peer). No explicit mention of 'Study 1', multiple studies, sample characteristics, or assessment methods appears in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Full section text: "With respect to our exploratory aim, a repeated measures ANOVA model produced a significant within group effect, F(3,238) = 166.52, p < .001, indicating notable mean differences in the figures selected to represent participants' current, personal ideal, ethnic group ideal, and the typical ethnic female peer body size adjusted for BMI. Bonferroni-corrected post hoc analyses more specifically revealed that on average students' current or actual body size rating was larger than the figure chosen for their personal ideal (p < .001, Cohen's d = 0.42) and the ideal body size for their ethnic group (p = .001, Cohen's d = 0.17) albeit the latter difference was relatively small in magnitude. On the other hand, participants on average perceived their actual body size to be somewhat smaller than their fellow ethnic female peer (p < .001, Cohen's d = -0.41). Additionally, the mean personal ideal body size rating was significantly smaller than the selected ethnic group ideal (p < .001, Cohen's d = -0.35) as well as the body size viewed as typical for an ethnic female peer (p < .001, Cohen's d = -1.13). Similarly, the average body size rating for the ethnic group ideal was smaller than the average body size chosen to reflect the typical ethnic female peer (p < .001, Cohen's d = -0.77)."
